title: Pre-RDO CICS resource macro tables in HLASM: alternative statement format with per-line remarks, remark continuations after column 16, SDSCI DCB folding, and refused non-resource macros
shapes: SHIP SHPTBL.asm: DFHFCT TYPE=FILE in HLASM alternative statement format (each continued line carries remarks after its trailing comma, followed by a continuation line starting in column 17 which HLASM treats as a remark) and retained TYPE=DATASET,DATASET=
SHIP SHPTBL.asm: DFHPCT TYPE=ENTRY with a sequence symbol (.PCT01) in the name field and a quoted operand containing spaces, routing transaction SHPM to SHPINQ
SHIP SHPTBL.asm: DFHPPT TYPE=ENTRY with PROGRAM=SHPMAP1,USAGE=MAP (a MAPSET) and PARTSET=SHPPSET (a PARTITIONSET)

SHIP SHPTBL.asm: DFHDCT TYPE=SDSCI folded into TYPE=EXTRA (with DESTID=SHPAUD truncated on the right to 4 characters: SHPA), DFHTST DATAID=(SHPT,SHPA), DFHJCT JFILEID=SYSTEM|02, DFHTCT TYPE=SYSTEM|REGION|TERMINAL|GPENTRY, DFHSRT RECOVER=YES, DFHMCT ID=(PP,4) (-> USER.203), DFHPLT PROGRAM=(SHPPLT1,SHPPLT2)|SHPPLT3 across DFHDELIM, DSNCRCT TYPE=INIT|GROUP|ENTRY (-> DB2CONN DFHRCT01 and DB2ENTRY SHPI/SHPM with PLANI inheritance), and DFHSIT SUFFIX=6$

SHIP SHPTBL.asm: non-resource statements that must produce no resource row (DFHDCT TYPE=SDSCI, DFHTST DATAID=() and TYPE=SHARED, DFHTCT TYPE=SDSCI and TYPE=LINE, DFHSRT RECOVER=NO, DFHMCT TYPE=RECORD, DFHPLT PROGRAM=DFHDELIM, DSNCRCT TYPE=COMD and TYPE=POOL)
asserts: Each resource-defining macro statement is a csd_resources fact with its assembled table name (macro + TYPE=INITIAL SUFFIX=, or DSNCRCT TYPE=GROUP) as group and the macro statement's first line as line; DFHPCT TYPE=ENTRY also records a transactions fact resolved to the estate's program. In HLASM alternative statement format, per-line remarks after a trailing comma and continuation lines starting after column 16 are ignored. Non-resource control macros (SDSCI, LINE, RECORD, SHARED, DATAID=(), RECOVER=NO, DFHDELIM, COMD, POOL) produce no resource fact.
